进入月相画面，先看地球、轨道上的月球、平行太阳光和旁边的月面示意；球体大小与距离: Open the phase diagram and inspect Earth, the Moon on its orbit, parallel sunlight and the adjacent lunar-disk illustration. Body sizes and distances are not to scale.
用鼠标或手指拖动轨道附近的月球，连续查看相位变化。这个操作同时改变实际日期与时刻: Drag the Moon near its orbit with a mouse or finger to follow phase changes continuously. This also changes the real date and time. To compare different dates strictly at the same time, use the date slider below while keeping time fixed.
每隔几天记录一次日期、月相名称和照明比例。月相周期约29.53天，不等于一个历月: Every few days, record date, phase name and illuminated fraction. The phase cycle is about 29.53 days, not one calendar month. Continue across months using the calendar; do not expect every month's first day to be a new moon.
切到月球天空，观察同一天里月球的高度和升落；再改日期比较同一时刻。月球日轨迹仅覆: Switch to Moon Sky to observe the Moon's altitude and rise/set during one day, then change the date to compare at the same time. A daily lunar path covers only 00:00–24:00 and usually does not close at its ends.
原理图的大月面是固定朝向示意，不能用它直接判断本地天空里亮面朝左还是朝右。真实天: The large lunar disk in the principle diagram has a fixed illustrative orientation; it cannot directly tell you whether the bright side is on the left or right in your local sky. Use Looking Up for the actual sky orientation. Hemisphere and viewing direction change the disk's orientation on-screen. A small Moon–planet angular separation does not guarantee naked-eye visibility; check altitude, daylight and the page's guidance.
任务单：一个月里固定时刻观察: Worksheet: observe a month at one fixed time
选定地点、月份与20:00当地真太阳时，暂停播放。每隔约3天改变日期，记录月相名: Choose a location and month, set 20:00 local apparent solar time and pause. Change the date by roughly three days at a time; record phase, illuminated fraction, lunar altitude and indicators such as “Below the Horizon.”
找到最接近新月、上弦、满月、下弦的日期，再用相邻日期细看。不要预设这些月相必定发: Find the dates nearest new moon, first quarter, full moon and last quarter, then inspect adjacent dates more closely. Do not assume those phases occur on a particular lunar-calendar or Gregorian-calendar day; use the ephemeris readings.
选一个月球在地平线上的日期，保持日期不变，拖动一天内的时刻。比较月相比例与天空位: Choose a date when the Moon is above the horizon and keep it fixed while moving the time through the day. Compare illuminated fraction with sky position: rising and setting are daily motion; the main phase period is about 29.53 days, although illumination also changes slowly during a single day.
切“月相”原理图或三维日地月，在同一时刻核对照明比例。外部相机看到的亮面、固定朝: Check the illuminated fraction at the same instant in the phase-principle diagram or 3D Sun–Earth–Moon view. The bright side seen by an external camera, a fixed-orientation phase diagram and the lunar disk's rotation in the local sky represent different viewing arrangements.
不要把“满月”解释为月球自己发光，也不要把月相解释为地球影子遮住月球；这里的常规: Do not explain full moon as the Moon producing its own light, or ordinary phases as Earth's shadow covering it. These diagrams show sunlight and viewing direction; eclipses require additional occultation conditions and are not simulated by this model.
在太阳界面直接选择“仰望天空”；在月相界面先点击“月球天空”，再选“仰望天空”。: In the Sun interface, select Looking Up directly. In Moon Phases, first select Moon Sky, then Looking Up.
用方位滑块或东南西北按钮转向，用时刻滑块改变观测时间。这两个操作分别改变朝向和时: Use the azimuth slider or cardinal-direction buttons to turn, and the time slider to change observation time. These operations change direction and time separately.
点击参数区的天体名称，让画面转向它。月面亮边会随当地天空方向转动；月相原理图仍是: Click a body's name in the parameter area to face it. The Moon's bright limb rotates with the local sky orientation; the phase-principle diagram keeps a fixed orientation. If a body is not visible, first read indicators such as “Behind You” or “Below the Horizon.”
在太阳界面需要对比月球时，展开“显示辅助”，开启“叠加月球视运动”，再固定地点、: To compare the Moon in the Sun interface, expand Display Aids, enable “Overlay the Moon's Apparent Motion,” then compare at fixed location, date and time.
记录时把“朝向”和“时刻”分开：先固定时刻，只改变面向方位，找到各天体；再固定朝: Record viewing direction separately from time. First fix time and turn to find each body; then fix direction and change time to see bodies rise, fall or leave the view. Planets drawn in daylight indicate position, not guaranteed naked-eye visibility. A body below the horizon cannot be seen directly from that location.
地面方位参考盘标出北、东、南、西，蓝点表示观察者站位，金色箭头表示正前方。拖动转: The ground-direction disk marks north, east, south and west. A blue dot marks the observer and a gold arrow points straight ahead. When you drag to turn, both the grid and direction labels change projection: facing south puts east on the left and west on the right; facing east puts north on the left. This is a directional aid, not an orbit, and it does not change body altitude. Direction at the poles follows a reference convention.
轨迹为什么没有接到地平线？: Why does the path not meet the horizon?
点击仰望天空视角上方“轨迹说明”。图中地平线是高度0°，不是天体会落到的实体表面: Select “Path Explanation” above Looking Up. The horizon is altitude 0°, not a physical surface on which bodies land. Orthographic projection gives curved left and right boundaries to the forward hemisphere. A path is clipped when it passes behind you, which need not happen at altitude 0°. The Moon's 00:00 and 24:00 endpoints may also remain above the horizon; they are not necessarily rise/set times.
可固定北京夏至附近的日期，先面向南，再转向东、北、西。东北日出和西北日落处于面向: Fix a date near the June solstice in Beijing and face south, then east, north and west. Northeastern sunrise and northwestern sunset are behind you when facing south, so the visible solar path's ends can lie above the horizon. In this project, geometric rising or setting occurs only when a body's center crosses altitude 0°.
任务单：月球与行星的同场观察: Worksheet: observe the Moon and planets together
先固定地点、日期与时刻，用四个方位按钮查找太阳、月球和行星，再点击天体名称对准它: Fix location, date and time. Use the four direction buttons to find the Sun, Moon and planets, then click a body's name to face it. Read its altitude to check whether it is above the horizon.
保持朝向不变，只拖动时刻，记录天体何时进入、离开前方半球。把“在身后”与“在地平: Keep direction fixed and move only the time. Record when bodies enter or leave the forward hemisphere. Distinguish “Behind You” from “Below the Horizon”: you can turn to see the former; the latter cannot be seen directly there at that time.
在月球模式开启行星伴月，记录月球与所选行星的角距，再查看双方高度和日照条件。角距: In Moon mode, enable Moon–Planet Pairing and record the angular separation from the selected planet. Check both altitudes and daylight conditions. A small separation means similar directions, not small physical distance or guaranteed naked-eye visibility.
画面上方选择日晷类型与“立体装置／盘面与安装”。晷上读时紧贴图形，时间和日期只用: Choose the sundial type and “3D Instrument / Dial and Installation” above the drawing. The dial reading stays beside the diagram; use only the controls below for time and date. By default, drag the 3D instrument to rotate it and pinch or use the wheel to zoom. Dragging the shadow changes time only after you select “Drag Shadow to Set Time.” Reset View leaves location and observation time unchanged. Parameters are grouped by observation location, instrument settings, clock-time comparison and construction principles.
在太阳实验台的“关联图解”菜单中点击“日晷实验台”，进入独立实验页；再用页面顶部: Select Sundial Lab from the Sun lab's Related Diagrams menu to open the independent experiment page. Then choose Horizontal Sundial or Equatorial Sundial using the buttons at the top.
先选择“水平日晷”，设置地点和日期，拖动图形下方的时刻滑块。图形上方显示当前装置: Choose Horizontal Sundial, set location and date, and move the time slider below the drawing. The current “Dial Reading” appears above it; switching types updates the reading and explanation together. At night, it reports no direct solar shadow. Select “Drag Shadow to Set Time” to drag the shadow or click the scale; you can also play through a day.
固定日期与时刻，只改变“晷针长度”，记录影线变化和读时；再切换“赤道日晷”，重复: Fix date and time and change only gnomon length. Record the shadow-line changes and dial reading. Then switch to Equatorial Sundial and repeat the comparison.
切到“盘面与安装”查看安装图。需要动手制作时展开“制作、安装与原理”；需要对照钟: Switch to Dial and Installation for the installation drawing. Expand “Construction, Installation and Principles” to make a physical sundial. For a clock comparison, expand Clock-time Comparison, enter the UTC offset and read the result.
先固定地点与日期，分别选上午、正午附近和下午，记录晷上读时、影线方向和当前装置类: Fix location and date, then select morning, near noon and afternoon. Record the dial reading, shadow direction and instrument type. Dragging to rotate changes only the viewing angle; time changes only in “Drag Shadow to Set Time” mode. Changing gnomon length changes shadow length, which must not be mistaken for a change in time.
水平日晷的盘面水平，晷针方向平行地轴；赤道日晷的盘面平行赤道面，针与盘面垂直。安: A horizontal sundial has a horizontal dial and a gnomon parallel to Earth's axis. An equatorial sundial has a dial parallel to the equatorial plane and a gnomon perpendicular to it. Install it according to local latitude and hemisphere, not merely the apparent tilt on-screen. Enter the correct UTC offset for clock comparison; daylight-saving time is not applied automatically. If the reading says “No Direct Solar Shadow” or is unreadable, first choose a time when the Sun is above the horizon, then check installation conditions.
任务单：装置、影子和钟表读数: Worksheet: instrument, shadow and clock readings
选北京和太阳在地平线上的时刻，先用“立体装置”旋转查看盘面和晷针。水平日晷是盘面: Choose Beijing and a time with the Sun above the horizon. In 3D Instrument, rotate to inspect the dial and gnomon. The horizontal type has a horizontal dial and an axis-parallel gnomon; the equatorial type has an equator-parallel dial and a perpendicular gnomon.
记录09:00、12:00、15:00三个真太阳时的影线和晷上读时。刻度受装置类: Record shadow lines and dial readings at 09:00, 12:00 and 15:00 apparent solar time. Scales depend on the instrument type; do not apply a horizontal sundial's scale pattern to an equatorial dial.
切“拖影调时”，拖动影子后看下方时刻是否同步；再切回旋转装置，检查旋转不应改变日: Select “Drag Shadow to Set Time,” drag the shadow and check that the time below updates. Switch back to instrument rotation and verify that rotating does not change date or time.
填写钟表时对照的UTC偏移，分别记录晷上读时和钟表时。差异需要结合经度与均时差解: Enter the UTC offset for clock comparison and record both dial and clock times. Explain the difference using longitude and the equation of time rather than assuming the sundial is broken. Across seasons, check the illuminated side of the equatorial dial and any unreadable indication.
比较针长时固定其余条件。针长改变影线长度，而影线方向所对应的刻度不应因此变成另一: Keep all other conditions fixed when comparing gnomon lengths. Length changes the shadow-line length; it should not change the time indicated by the shadow's direction.
在太阳页面顶部的小字导航中点击“日行迹”，进入独立实验页。原菜单入口也继续保留。: Select Analemma in the small top navigation on the Sun page to open its independent experiment. The original menu entry remains available.
参数区把“固定时刻的依据”选为钟表时，设置 UTC 偏移；在图形下方设置每日固定: In Parameters, set “Basis of Fixed Time” to Clock Time and enter the UTC offset. Set the daily fixed observation time below the diagram. Drag dates or play day by day and follow the marker around the annual path.
保持地点和时间依据不变，分别设置 09:00、12:00、15:00；也可开启三: Keep location and time basis fixed and try 09:00, 12:00 and 15:00. You may also overlay all three times. Drag the 3D diagram to inspect another direction, or use Reset Sky View.
再把依据切到“当地真太阳时”，记录轨迹怎样改变；每次记录中写明采用哪一种时间依据: Switch the basis to Local Apparent Solar Time and record how the path changes. State the time basis in every record.
展开“高级实验 · ‘8’字的成因”，启用理想成因实验。先只把倾角调到 0，再恢: Expand “Advanced Experiment · Causes of the Figure Eight” and enable the idealized cause experiment. Set only obliquity to 0, then restore reference values; set only eccentricity to 0 and restore them again. Finally, compare with both set to 0.
调参数时只滚动参数框，全年图形始终保留在上方或旁边。完成成因实验后关闭理想开关，: Scroll only within the parameter panel while changing settings; the annual diagram stays above or alongside it. Turn off the idealized experiment when finished, then resume real-date observation.
怎样记录成因比较: How to record the comparison of causes
先在真实日期模式完成一整年、同一钟表时的观察，再启用理想成因实验。记录每一轮的地: First observe a complete year at one clock time in real-date mode, then enable the idealized cause experiment. For each run, record location, time basis, fixed time, obliquity, eccentricity and path features. Change one parameter at a time and restore reference values afterward. Setting obliquity or eccentricity to 0 isolates an influence in an idealized model; it does not alter the real year's ephemeris.
改观测时刻时，先观察太阳在本地天空的位置和投影方向，再比较整条轨迹。三维投影可能: When changing observation time, first inspect the Sun's local sky position and projection direction, then compare the entire path. A 3D projection may overlap lines; rotate it or switch coordinate views. Dashed sections are below the horizon. Today's solar marker does not mean the Sun is visible on every date of the year. Fixed apparent solar time and fixed clock time are different bases and must be recorded separately.
任务单：为什么会有“8”字: Worksheet: why a figure eight appears
先关闭理想实验，固定地点、钟表时依据、UTC偏移与12:00。遍历全年，记录几个: Turn off the idealized experiment and fix location, Clock Time, UTC offset and 12:00. Scan the full year, noting points near solstices and equinoxes and their positions on the curve. Dashed parts lie below the horizon.
把时间改成09:00再改成15:00。先比较轨迹在天空中的位置，再旋转三维查看形: Change time to 09:00, then 15:00. Compare the path's sky position before rotating the 3D view to inspect its shape. Overlapping projections do not mean the time change failed.
恢复同一时刻，改为当地真太阳时。此时太阳时角固定，均时差造成的东西向年度摆动被消: Restore one fixed time and switch to Local Apparent Solar Time. Solar hour angle is now fixed, eliminating the annual east–west variation caused by the equation of time. Do not expect the same figure eight as under clock time.
在理想成因实验中先记录参考状态，再只将倾角设0；恢复参考值，再只将偏心率设0；最: In the idealized cause experiment, record the reference state, then set only obliquity to 0. Restore it, then set only eccentricity to 0; finally set both to 0. Use the same location, time and projection at every step and describe which parts of the curve change.
“大环在下、小环在上”不能脱离坐标和观看方向直接判断。相机旋转、时刻与投影会改变: “The large loop is below and the small loop above” is not meaningful without coordinates and viewing direction. Camera rotation, time and projection change their screen positions. Check the axis labels, months and selected coordinate system first.
入口在“实验台 → 关联图解 → 空间模型”，或关联图解页的“空间模型”菜单；也: Enter through “Lab → Related Diagrams → Spatial Models,” the Spatial Models menu on Related Diagrams, or the 3D Sky top link. Choose 3D Solar System for the eight planets or Sun–Earth–Moon Relationships for Earth and Moon directly. This page uses independent UTC time and does not change the original lab's location, date or time.
拖动画面旋转相机，滚轮或双指缩放。旋转只改变观察角度，不改变日期或真实天体坐标；: Drag to rotate the camera and use the wheel or pinch to zoom. Rotation changes only the viewing angle, not the date or physical coordinates. The upper-right reset button restores the current view. On a computer, arrow keys rotate and plus/minus keys zoom.
在图形下方拖动日期轴，或使用日历定位。日历定位到所选日期的12:00 UTC，连: Drag the date axis below the drawing or use the calendar. The calendar selects 12:00 UTC on the chosen date; continuous dragging and playback retain fractional-day time. Read the UTC time beside the date rather than interpreting it as local apparent solar time.
固定相机，设置每秒推进的天数，点击播放，比较同一时间间隔内内外行星的运动。取消“: Fix the camera, set days advanced per second and select Play to compare inner and outer planets over the same interval. With “Loop Current Year” off, playback stops at the year's date-axis endpoint. Use the calendar to select another year before a cross-year observation.
切换“日地月”，开启“平行太阳光线”，比较太阳方向箭头与光线方向：箭头指向太阳，: Switch to Sun–Earth–Moon and enable Parallel Sunlight. Compare the arrow toward the Sun with the light rays: the arrow points to the Sun, while rays travel in the opposite direction toward Earth and Moon. Change dates to observe the Moon's spatial position and geocentric illuminated fraction. The illuminated side seen by an external camera is not automatically the phase seen from Earth.
手机点击标题旁“参数”打开侧拉菜单，调完后关闭再继续看图。触屏拖动实时旋转，双指: On a phone, select Parameters beside the title, adjust the drawer and close it to continue observing. Touch dragging rotates in real time; pinching does not change the date.
沉浸式全屏观察：保留控制，让画面占主位: Immersive full-window observation: keep controls while prioritizing the view
链接打开满窗口布局；在三维页点击“沉浸观察”时，支持的浏览器也会进入系统全屏。S: opens a full-window layout. Selecting Immersive Observation on the 3D page also requests system fullscreen in supporting browsers. If Safari or another browser does not support or allows no fullscreen, the full-window layout remains usable.
顶部保留太阳系／日地月切换，底部保留UTC、播放、日期与滑条。详细参数点击右上角: Solar System / Sun–Earth–Moon selectors remain at the top; UTC, playback, date and slider remain at the bottom. Open detailed settings with Parameters at the upper right, then close them to rotate and zoom again. There is no second set of time controls.
先暂停，转动相机找到要看的天体，再点名称或通过“观察 → 天体近景”靠近。需要舒: Pause first and rotate the camera to find your object, then select its name or use “Observe → Body Close-ups.” For a gentler demonstration of position changes, choose 2 days/second in Parameters. This is accelerated time, not real-time celestial motion.
开启轨道便于辨认公转路径；需要干净画面时关闭轨道或名称。日地月中开启“地轴与赤道: Enable orbits to identify orbital paths; turn off orbits or names for a clearer view. In Sun–Earth–Moon, enable Axis and Equator to distinguish the red axis, blue equator ring and ecliptic reference plane.
按“退出沉浸”返回正常布局；键盘Esc先关闭已打开的参数菜单，再退出沉浸。退出只: Select Exit Immersive to restore the normal layout. Esc closes an open parameter drawer first, then exits immersion. Exiting changes only layout: it does not reset bodies, camera or UTC, and does not automatically start playback.
The background catalog contains 61,816 HYG stars with J2000 directions. Normal mode shows the 8,920 stars with apparent magnitude ≤6.5; immersive mode extends to ≤8.5. Magnitude controls brightness, and color index approximates blue-white versus warm colors. No atmospheric twinkling is added in this spatial view. Glow, point size and exposure are display treatments, not stellar diameters or precision astrometry. This mode shares the original ephemeris and renderer and does not enable an automatic orbiting camera. Fix the camera before playing to distinguish physical position changes from changes in viewpoint.
卫星、小行星与真实星云影像: Moons, asteroids and real nebula images
进入沉浸模式，打开右下角“观察 → 太阳系与深空细节”。卫星群、主带小行星、周期: In immersive mode, open “Observe → Solar System and Deep-sky Details” at the lower right. Satellite groups, main-belt asteroids, periodic comets and nebula backgrounds have separate switches. New objects appear as unnamed points by default to avoid covering the diagram.
在太阳系总览比较各行星附近的卫星群；水星、金星没有已知天然卫星。选择一颗行星后，: In the Solar System overview, compare satellite groups near each planet. Mercury and Venus have no known natural moons. After selecting a planet, choose Observe Selected Planet's Moons to frame the planet and its available orbital-data points more clearly. Select Solar System to return to the overview.
当前快照包含JPL轨道表中八大行星的455颗卫星。它是可用轨道数据的覆盖范围，不: The current snapshot contains 455 moons of the eight planets from JPL orbital tables. This is coverage of available orbital data, not a continuously updated worldwide discovery count. Apart from the Moon and Jupiter's four Galilean moons, motion is approximated from fixed mean orbital elements. Use it to observe prograde/retrograde motion and spatial distribution, not predict occultations or precise encounter times.
主带层包含按JPL绝对星等筛选的1,200颗小行星，并非整个小行星带；彗星层包含: The main-belt layer contains 1,200 asteroids selected by JPL absolute magnitude, not the entire asteroid belt. The comet layer has 12 elliptical-orbit periodic comets. Both appear only in the Solar System overview and share the existing UTC controls. Point size, brightness and compressed distance are not physical observing quantities.
星云背景默认关闭；可选的“星云影像背景”使用真实公开望远镜影像，在对象大致方向放: Nebula backgrounds are off by default. Optional Nebula Image Backgrounds use real public telescope images, enlarged in approximately their source directions; their screen extent is not their true angular diameter. Select View Real Nebula Images to browse Orion, the Ring Nebula and Mystic Mountain in the Carina Nebula, with original public images and sources.
星云是远处星际气体与尘埃结构，不是行星卫星，也不在太阳系内部。这里的多波段与处理: Nebulae are distant interstellar gas and dust structures, not planetary moons or objects inside the Solar System. These multi-band and processed-color images are not naked-eye views. Turn off the background to continue using catalog stars as directional references. Esc closes the image window before exiting immersion.
比较卫星时先暂停并固定相机；再只改变UTC日期。新增点群是独立展示层，不替换原实: Pause and fix the camera before comparing satellites, then change only the UTC date. The new point groups are independent display layers; they do not replace the original lab's geographic readings, phases or planetary positions. Return to the original lab for local rise/set observations.
放大前后怎样看卫星: Viewing moons before and after zooming
暂停日期播放，选中地球或木星，进入近景；在“观察”菜单开启行星卫星群，需要时使用: Pause date playback, select Earth or Jupiter and enter a close-up. Enable planetary moons in Observe and use Observe Selected Planet's Moons when needed.
固定UTC，只改变缩放，观察行星与卫星点一起随透视变大或变小；不要把光点直径当作: Fix UTC and change only zoom. Watch the planet and satellite points enlarge or shrink together with perspective; do not treat point diameter as physical satellite diameter.
再固定相机，推进日期，区分卫星的运动与相机的变化。点群没有名称，具体对象识别不能: Fix the camera again and advance dates to distinguish satellite motion from camera changes. Points have no names, so their sizes alone cannot identify individual objects.

固定地点、日期和地面，先使用竖直杆。水平地面上的影长关系适用于太阳在地平线上方且: Fix place, date and the ground, starting with a vertical rod. The horizontal-ground shadow-length relation applies when the Sun is above the horizon and the rod is vertical.

改变日期并保留一个参考，比较影尖轨迹；太阳接近地平线时单独记录显示范围的限制。: Keep a reference and change the date to compare paths; separately record display limits near the horizon.
影子方向与太阳水平投影相反。相同太阳高度下，竖直杆的影长与杆高成比例；夜间不应有: A shadow points opposite the Sun’s horizontal projection. For vertical rods at one solar altitude, shadow length is proportional to rod height; at night no direct-sunlight ground shadow should appear.

任务六：日晷为什么可以计时？: Investigation 6: Why can a sundial tell time?

分别观察水平式与赤道式，识别晷针、晷面与地轴的关系。: Inspect horizontal and equatorial versions and identify the gnomon, dial plane and rotation axis.
在几个整点暂停，比较影线与时刻标记；记录不能得到有效交点的情形。: Pause at several whole hours and compare shadow lines with hour markings, recording cases without a valid intersection.
只改变纬度，观察水平日晷刻度和晷针方向怎样变化。: Change latitude alone and observe changes in the horizontal dial and gnomon orientation.
切换到另一季节，检查赤道晷面受光的正反面及日照可用性。: Change the season and inspect which side of the equatorial plane is illuminated and whether direct sunlight is available.
水平式刻度通常不等距；赤道式利用与地球自转轴垂直的平面表达时角。不同装置的刻度不: Horizontal hour markings are generally unequal; an equatorial plane represents hour angle around the rotation axis. The markings cannot be interchanged between designs.
装置几何决定光线与晷面的交点。太阳时、钟表时和经度改正不同，模型设置的固定偏移不: The apparatus geometry determines ray–plane intersections. Solar time, civil time and longitude corrections differ, and a fixed offset does not automatically handle daylight saving.

月相主要由日地月相对几何决定。当天可能只有月出或只有月落事件；月球并不保证每天在: Phase mainly reflects Sun–Earth–Moon geometry. A calendar day may contain only a rise or only a set; the Moon does not recur at a fixed clock time each day.
月球亮面方向还与本地朝向和观察视角有关。月相示意中的距离和大小可能经过教学放大，: Bright-limb orientation also depends on local orientation and viewpoint. Teaching-scale sizes and distances in a phase diagram cannot establish eclipses.

固定地点和真实日期，选择月球与一个行星。角距离是两条视线夹角，不是公里距离。: Fix place and real date and choose the Moon and a planet. Angular separation is an angle between sight lines, not a distance in kilometers.

仰望画面是当地天空方向投影，三维太阳系则是经过比例处理的空间示意；两者可以相互解: The local-sky display projects viewing directions, while the 3D Solar System is a scale-adjusted spatial illustration. They complement each other but their displayed distances are not interchangeable.
解释一次伴月搜索结果不能保证肉眼可见，并写出还需核对的观测条件。: Explain why a search result does not guarantee naked-eye visibility and list additional observing conditions to check.

在理想成因实验中分别调整地轴倾角和轨道偏心率，每次只改一项，再与真实日期模式比较: In the idealized cause experiment, vary axial tilt and orbital eccentricity separately, then compare with real-date mode.
真实钟表时采样同时包含赤纬变化和均时差影响。固定真太阳时会去掉由均时差引起的时角: Fixed civil-clock sampling combines declination changes with the equation of time. Fixed apparent solar time removes the corresponding hour-angle variation, although different projections can still produce geometric curvature.
地轴倾斜与轨道非圆共同影响太阳在固定钟表时的方向。理想成因模型用于隔离变量，不等: Axial tilt and a noncircular orbit affect the direction at a fixed civil clock time. The ideal model isolates causes; it is not merely a different visual style for the real ephemeris.
在记录表中明确写出采样依据、UTC偏移、采样时刻、地点与模型模式，缺一项就难以复: Record sampling basis, UTC offset, sample clock, location and model mode; omitting any of them makes reproduction difficult.

绕月运动改变视线与月面边缘的关系。固定近地侧月面在同步自转简化模型中不会每天看到: Orbital motion changes the sight line relative to the lunar limb. At a fixed near-side site in this synchronous-rotation model, Earth does not rise and set daily, although its illuminated fraction can vary.
模块未模拟真实月球天平动、地形遮挡和精确任务轨迹；不能把教学飞行速度当作真实轨道: The lesson omits lunar libration, terrain and precise mission trajectories. Animation speed is not the physical orbital period.

天空图只有一个目录入口；空间视图、俯视日影、地平视角和仰望天空集中在天空图标题栏: Sky has one catalog entry. Spatial, overhead-shadow, horizon and looking-up viewpoints are grouped in the sky pane header.
不是每个独立模块都能嵌入组合。目录中有加入控件的内容才支持加入；地升地落和搭建保: Only entries offering an add control support composition. Earthrise and construction retain their independent scenes.
四个视角共享基准地点、日期和时刻。改变视角不应改变这些科学条件。: The four viewpoints share the baseline location, date and clock; switching viewpoints does not change them.
空间视图：拖动旋转相机，滚轮或双指缩放，使用复位视角恢复；查看日轨迹、杆和影子。: Spatial view: drag the camera, scroll or pinch to zoom and use Reset view. Inspect the daily path, rod and shadow.
俯视日影：从地面上方比较影长、方向和影尖轨迹；显示放大倍率只影响画面尺度。: Overhead shadow: compare length, direction and tip paths from above; display magnification changes the display scale only.
地平视角：从地平线附近看升落和高度变化，注意虚线表示地平线下的延伸。: Horizon view: inspect rising, setting and altitude changes, noting dashed below-horizon extensions.
仰望天空：转动朝向寻找太阳、月球或行星。转头不同于改变观测地点。: Looking up: turn toward the Sun, Moon or planets. Turning the view is different from relocating the observer.
显示辅助中的轨迹、角度线、影子、影尖记录和月球叠加按当前模式提供。夜间、极昼、极: Display aids offer tracks, angle references, shadows, tip traces and lunar overlays where supported. At night, during polar conditions or close to the horizon, shadow readings may be absent or extend beyond the canvas.
地球与昼夜、地图和地轴图: Earth, daylight, maps and axis geometry
地球与昼夜连接太阳方向、直射点、观察地点与昼夜分布；地轴与地平面图连接地轴、赤道: Earth & daylight connects sunlight, the subsolar point, observer and day–night pattern. Axis & horizon connects the rotation axis, equator and local horizon.
在球面视图与全球平面图间选择。球面拖动默认可以只旋转视角，先检查拖动规则。: Choose globe or world map and check the drag rule before interacting; a globe gesture can rotate only the view.
使用取动观测地点或拖动明确的观察点移动地点；选择固定同一UTC瞬间或固定当地真太: Use the explicit observer-move mode or observer marker, choosing fixed UTC or fixed apparent solar time.
需要只改纬度或经度时使用移动约束；对准观察地点用于调整相机朝向。: Use movement constraints to change only latitude or longitude. Align observer location changes the camera orientation.
在地轴图拖动相机核对不同平面关系；用图例识别地轴、赤道面、地平面、天顶和太阳方向: Rotate the axis view and use its legend to distinguish axis, equator, horizon, zenith and sunlight.
太阳模式横轴是当地真太阳时，纵轴是太阳高度；月球照明图采用另一种横纵轴，不能直接: The solar chart uses apparent solar time horizontally and altitude vertically. The lunar illumination chart has different axes.
沿曲线点选时刻，与下方公共时间栏和天空中的当前位置互相核对。: Select a time on the curve and cross-check the lower clock and current sky position.
在自定义里添加日期对照曲线，用该对象自己的日期滑条或日历改变参考日期。: Add a date comparison curve in customization and change its reference date using the object’s own slider or calendar.
添加水平参考线、时刻标记或两点时间与高度差测量，读清起止点和单位。: Add horizontal levels, time markers or two-point time/altitude differences and check endpoints and units.
比较曲线峰值、过零、全天高于零或低于零的情况；重合曲线可能来自相同条件。: Compare peaks, zero crossings and curves wholly above or below zero. Identical conditions may produce overlapping curves.
事件按天体中心穿越几何地平线计算，不包含大气折射、山地遮挡或太阳视半径修正。方向: Events use the body center crossing the geometric horizon, without atmospheric refraction, terrain or solar-radius corrections. Cardinal directions stay fixed rather than rotating to fabricate readings.
点击出或落的端点，跳到相应事件时刻。: Click a rise or set endpoint to jump to that event time.
按住端点拖向另一个方位，系统保持地点不变并反求能接近目标的日期，各图与下方日期同: Drag an endpoint toward another bearing. The site stays fixed while the date is searched, updating other views and the shared date.
太阳在当前年份内寻找日期，月球在原日期前后五周内寻找；超出可实现范围时停在最近结: Solar dates are searched within the current year, lunar dates within five weeks of the original date. Unreachable targets use the nearest achievable result with an explanation.
左右键按日调日期；滚轮或双指缩放；Home复位缩放；拖动中Esc取消并恢复原日期: Left/Right changes date by a day; scroll or pinch zooms; Home resets zoom; Escape cancels a drag and restores its starting date.
没有当天事件时没有可拖端点。应先用日期和地点控制寻找有事件的条件。极点不赋予唯一: No endpoint is draggable if that event is absent. Use date or location controls first. At a pole the model does not assign a unique bearing.
切到月相后，系统保留太阳与月球各自设置，并在视图目录提供适合月球的内容。: Moon mode retains separate solar and lunar settings and offers lunar-specific views in the catalog.
月相与关系：观察日地月位置、地球视角亮面和月球轨道相位。: Phase relationships: inspect Sun–Earth–Moon geometry, the Earth-based bright portion and orbital phase.
逐日照明比例：按日期比较月面照明比例，用当前日期点核对月相图。: Daily illumination: compare illuminated fraction over dates and cross-check the current date with the phase diagram.
月出月落：读取该日一个或两个事件，缺少事件不一定是异常。: Moonrise/set: inspect the day’s events; a missing rise or set can be valid.
行星伴月：选择行星、检查角距离和地平线位置，使用日期范围搜索时保留其地点和时间依: Moon & planets: select a planet, check separation and horizon position, and preserve the observer and time basis for range searches.
伴月表示方向接近，不是物理碰撞或实际距离接近。搜索结果也不包含天气、地形、背景亮: A close approach is directional, not a collision or necessarily close physical spacing. Search results do not fully assess weather, terrain, sky brightness or visual detection limits.
在月相模式从关联图解进入地升地落。轨道示意和宇航员视角使用同一个绕月状态；本模块: Open Earthrise through Related diagrams in Moon mode. The orbital diagram and astronaut view share one orbital state; the module does not treat the Lab date as a real mission trajectory.
选择绕月观察或固定月面。绕月模式可调位置角、高度、飞行时长和日地月构型。: Choose orbit or fixed surface. Orbit mode adjusts position angle, altitude, animation duration and Sun–Earth–Moon configuration.
点击看地升找到地球从月面边缘出现的位置，再播放或暂停。: Use Watch Earthrise to find emergence at the lunar limb, then play or pause.
地球在画面外时使用朝向地球或Home；拖动宇航员画面只是转头。: Use Look toward Earth or Home when Earth is off screen; dragging the astronaut view turns the head only.
手机可切换轨道图和宇航员视图；仍从左侧视图与布局返回其他模块，观测条件栏调本模块: On phones switch between orbital and astronaut views. Use Views & layout to leave the module and Observation controls for its parameters.
固定月面模式禁用绕月位置、高度和飞行播放等不适用控制。模型采用同步自转、球面月球: Fixed-surface mode disables inapplicable orbital angle, altitude and flight controls. The model uses synchronous rotation, a spherical Moon and a circular orbit without libration or terrain.
日行迹显示同一地点全年在固定采样时刻的太阳方向。标题栏标明采样时刻与依据，下方公: The analemma records solar direction through a year at a fixed sample clock for one site. Its header labels sampling time and basis; the lower timeline retains current observing conditions.
选择当地天空三维示意、天空坐标或赤纬与时角等可用投影。: Choose an available projection such as the local 3D sky, sky coordinates or declination/hour angle.
设置全年采样时刻、固定钟表时或固定真太阳时，以及钟表时的UTC固定偏移。: Set the annual sample clock, fixed civil or apparent-solar basis and the fixed UTC offset for civil time.
需要与公共时刻联动时勾选跟随真太阳时；手动改采样时刻或依据会解除该联动。: Link to the shared apparent-solar clock when needed; changing sample time or basis unlinks it.
叠加不同固定时刻、地点或参考轨迹；小画幅会减少月份文字，当前月份优先。: Overlay clocks, sites or reference tracks. Small panes reduce month labels and prioritize the current month.
成因实验独立调整地轴倾角和轨道偏心率；完成后回到真实日期模式再解释真实星历。: In the cause experiment, vary tilt and eccentricity independently, then return to real-date mode before interpreting the ephemeris.
日晷相关页面和实验台控制提供杆影、水平式与赤道式装置。它们与教学图解共享地点和太: Sundial pages and Lab controls provide rod shadows and horizontal/equatorial apparatus. They share location and sunlight with teaching diagrams, while display scaling is distinct from physical dimensions.
先选择装置或日影视图，再设置纬度、日期、时刻和杆高等适用参数。: Choose apparatus or shadow view, then set applicable latitude, date, clock and rod height.
比较轨道、俯视、影尖轨迹或装置视角，使用复位恢复相机。: Compare orbit, overhead, tip-path or apparatus viewpoints and reset the camera when needed.
核对太阳时和固定时区偏移的读数说明，不把晷面刻度自动解释为本地法定时间。: Check solar-time and fixed-offset explanations rather than assuming civil local time.
太阳低于地平线或光线与晷面无有效交点时，按提示判断可用性，不强求一个读数。: When the Sun is below the horizon or no valid ray–plane intersection exists, use the status instead of expecting a reading.
统一开关位于顶部语言按钮旁；进入后保留原观测控制，并启用图中对象、加入或移除图位: The common switch sits beside language. Entering preserves original observation controls and enables references, composition changes, layout editing and construction. No unexplained reference circle is automatically added.
先选需要的图，再从图中对象点击添加对象；使用目标任务的快捷方案，或展开自由工具。: Choose the relevant view, open Plot objects and Add objects, then use a goal-based recipe or advanced tools.
需要点选位置的工具会给出放置提示；在图上点击，或使用可用的放在中央操作。: Placement tools provide a hint; click the plot or use the available center-placement action.
选择列表或图中对象后，在属性中用滑条预览、用输入框精调；对象的显隐与锁定控制分别: Select a row or plotted reference and use sliders or precise inputs. Visibility and locking are separate controls.
每行更多菜单提供适用的保存、复制、删除；撤销和重做管理对象操作。连续滑条拖动合并: Each row’s More menu offers applicable save, duplicate and delete actions. Undo/redo handles reference edits; a continuous slider drag is grouped, and Escape cancels an active gesture.
完成自定义保留当前组合，隐藏编辑把手；再次进入可继续编辑。刷新默认回到普通模式，: Finishing retains the composition and hides editing handles. Re-enter to continue. Refresh starts in normal mode, with drafts restored according to session rules.

地点或时刻轨迹、参考高度与方向、日期标签: Site/clock tracks, altitude/direction guides and date labels

实际工具按当前图、天体和模式筛选，不是每张图都有同一组工具。轨迹对象、快照和观察: Tools are filtered by view, body and mode; not every plot offers the same set. Tracks, snapshots and observer stations have view-specific meanings.
对照对象附加在基准实验之上。添加城市不会自动移动原观测地点；相同条件的两条曲线可: Comparison references are added to the baseline experiment. Adding a city does not relocate the baseline, and identical conditions can produce overlapping curves.
同一瞬间不同地点：从添加对象的地点任务选城市并开始；默认按同一UTC瞬间比较。: Different places at one instant: choose a city in the place recipe and start, using the shared UTC instant.
选择城市后拖动经纬度；离开预设坐标时自动名称改为自定义地点与坐标，手动命名保持不: Scrub coordinates after selecting the city. Leaving preset coordinates updates an automatic name to a custom location; a manual name remains.
在固定UTC与固定当地真太阳时间选择实验依据；跨午夜时读清对照的当地日期。: Choose fixed UTC or equal apparent solar time and check local dates across midnight.
选中城市后，各相关图的同一对象突出，其他对照淡化；用设为基准地点才改变原地点。: Selecting a city emphasizes it across related views and dims others; Make baseline explicitly relocates the primary observer.
同地不同时刻方案可加入早晚标记；用对象时间滑条调整。日期曲线则使用自己的日期，不: The same-place recipe adds earlier/later clock markers with their own slider. Date curves use their own dates without changing the shared date.
独立的地点与时间对照场景还可一次显示当前与前后时刻，或当前与两个对照地点；时间间: The dedicated place/time scene can show the current and surrounding clocks or the baseline and two comparison locations, with interval, sites and readings in its observation controls.
搭建杆、球、圈与测量: Construct rods, spheres, circles and measurements
搭建实验从空白地面或明确标识的已存场景开始。太阳与月球拥有独立的物体场景；地面是: Construction starts with empty ground or an explicitly restored scene. Sun and Moon use separate object scenes; the ground is a teaching model rather than arbitrary terrain.
选择杆、球、参考圈、平面、刻度盘、观察站、标记点或文字，再点击地面放置；可一次添: Choose a rod, sphere, circle, plane, dial, station, marker or note and click the ground; multiple items can be placed at once.
用属性滑条调整位置、尺寸、高度、方向和允许的倾斜。先检查保持竖直、贴合地面、锁定: Adjust position, dimensions, elevation, direction and permitted tilt, checking upright, grounded, locked and grid-snap constraints.
使用圆周、等距、对齐等适用排列；多选后读清对整组或单个物体的操作范围。: Use applicable circular, equally spaced or aligned arrangements and check whether operations target one object or a group.
选择相应物体建立距离、角度或影长测量；记录运动时检查轨迹长度和样本范围。: Choose the required objects for distance, angle or shadow measurements and check trail length and sampling when recording motion.
保留一份场景参考，再只改变一个条件进行对照；增加文字说明记录实验假设。: Keep a reference scene and change one condition for comparison, adding notes to record assumptions.
改变相机不会移动物体。约束会限制可编辑范围；被锁定的物体不能直接拖走。月球光照与: Camera changes do not relocate objects. Constraints limit edits, and locked objects cannot be dragged. Interpret lunar lighting and shadow readings according to the current mode.
多图工作区复用同一批科学画布和一个公共时间栏。最多可以容纳六张适合组合的图；超过: The multi-view workspace reuses scientific canvases and one shared clock. Up to six composable views are supported; more than four scroll vertically, while phones switch through view tabs.
进入自定义后，从目录加入图；排列与收藏中选择一至四图的快捷数量或常用组合。: Enter customization and add views from the catalog; use count presets or quick combinations in Arrangement & saved layouts.
两图可左右并排或上下排列；三图可均衡或主辅布局。拖动把手交换顺序，或使用顺序按钮: Two views can be side by side or stacked, and three can be balanced or featured. Reorder by handles or order controls.
拖动分隔线预览比例，松手更新画布；精确输入比例允许30%至70%，确认后应用。: Drag dividers to preview proportions and release to resize the canvases, or commit an exact proportion from 30% to 70%.
点击专注此图临时放大；Esc返回组合。撤销与重做布局不等于撤销科学条件。: Focus a pane temporarily and press Escape to return. Layout undo/redo is separate from scientific-condition history.
添加图解只有目录中的一个入口；收藏栏不再重复列出一套添加按钮。完成自定义后保留组: The catalog is the single add-view entry; saved-layout settings do not repeat those buttons. Finishing retains the composition while hiding editing handles and dividers.
保存范围分为会话草稿、独立对象或场景存档、布局收藏和完整实验。先选对范围，再判断: Storage covers session drafts, individual reference/scene saves, layout collections and full experiments. Choose the scope before relying on refresh or another device.
只收藏排列：打开排列与收藏，保持连同观测与对象保存未勾选，命名后保存组合。: For layout only, leave Include conditions and objects off in Arrangement & saved layouts, enter a name and save.
保存完整实验：勾选该选项，命名后保存；它包括观测状态、布局、当前天体的图中对象和: For a full experiment, select the option and save a name; this includes observation state, layout, current-body references and construction objects.
点击带完整实验标记的收藏恢复。恢复后暂停播放；无效的完整记录会拒绝应用，不部分覆: Select a save marked Full experiment to restore it paused. Invalid full records are rejected without partially replacing the current experiment.
收藏可重命名、用当前内容更新或删除，最多五项；同名保存用于更新。对象行的独立保存: Up to five saves can be renamed, updated or removed; reusing a name updates it. Individual reference and ground-scene saves remain available.
跨设备分享时同时提供文字条件和可用的对象JSON导出；不要把浏览器本地收藏当作云: For another device, provide written conditions and available object JSON exports rather than assuming cloud-account synchronization.
当前会话中的参考编辑和实验状态: Reference edits and experiment state within the session
关页、存储限制和跨页面行为以提示为准: Subject to session lifetime, storage limits and page behavior
观测状态、布局、当前天体参考对象和搭建场景: Observation state, layout, current-body references and constructed scene
当前图对象或搭建场景: Current plot references or constructed scene
与收藏独立，按各入口标注的范围保存: Separate from collections and scoped by the specific control
浏览器拒绝存储或空间不足时，系统会提示仅本次访问可用。不要关闭页面后才检查是否保: If storage is denied or full, the status explains visit-only availability. Check the result before closing the page rather than assuming persistence.
三维天空是独立渲染器，使用UTC日期、真实物理向量和教学显示尺度。顶部文档中心与: 3D Sky uses an independent renderer, UTC dates, physical vectors and teaching display scales. Documentation and customization remain in the stable top navigation area.
太阳系总览中点击行星或侧栏列表选择天体；靠近观察与重置只改变相机。: Select a planet in the scene or list; approach and reset actions change the camera only.
切换日地月关系观察照明、姿态和月球轨道。物理距离与显示距离按说明区分。: Use Sun–Earth–Moon relationships for lighting, orientation and the lunar orbit, distinguishing physical and display distances.
通过观察菜单调整相机和显示；拖动旋转、滚轮或双指缩放，键盘方向和缩放键以画面提示: Use Observe for camera/display options, drag to rotate and scroll or pinch to zoom; follow the pane’s keyboard hints.
在参考对照中选择参考平面或当地观察位置，查看同一UTC瞬间的图解。: Choose a reference plane or local observer for a diagram comparison at the same UTC instant.
调整日期与播放速度，核对UTC、循环范围和停止边界；沉浸模式保留参数抽屉。: Adjust date and playback rate, checking UTC, looping and boundaries; immersive mode retains the parameter drawer.
星空、卫星、小天体和星云等探索内容按相应选择器提供。不同对象可能使用目录、近似轨: Available exploration controls cover stars, satellites, small bodies and nebulae. Different objects may use catalogs, approximate orbits or processed imagery; source and license labels are not measurement-accuracy guarantees.
实验台的三维对照可在保留当地科学图的同时打开关联三维场景；共享UTC，但相机独立: Lab’s 3D comparison retains the local scientific view alongside a linked spatial scene. UTC is shared while cameras remain independent. If WebGL is unavailable, continue in the 2D Lab.
浏览器后退前进、对象撤销、布局撤销和相机复位分别作用于不同范围。以按钮名称和当前: Browser history, object undo, layout undo and camera reset have different scopes. Follow the named action and keyboard focus.
需要恢复观测参数或主要选择时使用浏览器后退与前进；恢复后播放暂停。: Use browser Back/Forward for observing parameters and major selections; playback is paused on restore.
在对象或布局编辑区使用本区撤销重做；连续滑条操作合并记录，Esc取消正在进行的拖: Use local undo/redo for reference or layout edits; continuous scrubs are grouped, and Escape cancels an active drag or placement.
Tab按顺序移动焦点；原生滑条可用方向键微调。图形方向键的含义以图内说明为准。: Use Tab for focus and arrow keys for native slider adjustment. Canvas arrow-key behavior follows that view’s hint.
手机通过参数抽屉与图名标签切换；关闭抽屉后再操作图形。沉浸模式先退出已展开的工具: Phones use the parameter drawer and view tabs; close the drawer before plotting gestures. In immersive mode, close an open tool before Escape exits immersion.
